title: I'm Not a Regressor
altTitles: 俺は回帰者じゃないけれど
description: One day, a silver-haired goddess appears before Lee Shin-hyuk and declares him to be the star of the heavenly rebellion, the one who goes against fate, and the sole savior of a world destined to end. She insists that he is a regressor, but Shin-hyuk denies it. As he becomes entangled with the fate of a world on the brink of destruction, he must uncover why the goddess believes he has returned from the future and what role he is truly meant to play.
author: Butterfly Valley
